description: I’m Hamdan Sayed, Team Owner for Earth in Motion (Dancing with the SARs). Passionate about space tech and Earth observation, I specialize in web prototyping, data visualization, and translating NASA-ISRO NISAR radar data into interactive apps. We already have a live prototype tracking floods, wildfires, glaciers, and subsidence—join us to level up our data pipelines and pitch! Seeking teammates skilled in remote sensing/GIS, frontend/UI, or video storytelling.
